info.title: Japan Weather Forecast & Warnings API
info.description: Japanese weather forecasts, meteorological warnings/advisories, and weather discussions, sourced live from 気象庁 (Japan Meteorological Agency). x402-enabled for AI agents that plan travel, logistics, events, or alerts around Japanese weather.

get.summary: Get the JMA weather forecast for a Japanese area
get.description: Get the Japanese (JP) weather forecast for a region — today's conditions, near-term outlook, and a 7-day weekly forecast with temperatures and precipitation probability. Sourced live from 気象庁 (Japan Meteorological Agency / JMA). Accepts a JMA office code or a Japanese/English region name.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: JMA area code or Japanese place-name alias (e.g. 130000 or 東京)

get.summary: Get the JMA weather overview text for a Japanese area
get.description: Get the official 気象庁 (JMA) narrative weather discussion (気象概況) for a Japanese (JP) region, with a concise AI-readable English/Japanese summary.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: JMA area code or Japanese place-name alias (e.g. 130000 or 東京)

get.summary: List active JMA weather warnings for a Japanese area
get.description: List active meteorological warnings and advisories (気象警報・注意報) for a Japanese (JP) region — heavy rain, storm, snow, flood, storm surge, emergency (特別警報) tiers — sourced live from 気象庁 (JMA).

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: JMA area code or Japanese place-name alias (e.g. 130000 or 東京)

get.summary: List Japanese forecast areas and aliases
get.description: List every JMA forecast office (府県予報区) in Japan with its code, Japanese/English name, and class10 sub-regions. Use this to discover valid `:area` values.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

post.summary: Get weather for multiple Japanese areas in one call
post.description: Fetch weather forecasts for many Japanese (JP) regions in one request (up to 50). Dynamic pricing by item count with a volume discount.

402.description: Payment required (x402). Payment requirements are in the base64-encoded Payment-Required response header.

items.description: Areas to forecast in one call (max 50). Each item has an `id` (echoed back) and an `area` (JMA office code or region name).
